title: Soft Window Light Portrait
description: A gentle indoor portrait of a woman beside a large window on an overcast day. The light is wide and soft, shadows are barely there and skin looks natural rather than retouched. It suits personal branding, writers and wellness creators.
promptText: Indoor portrait of a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, seated beside a large window on an overcast morning, turned slightly toward the glass with a relaxed, soft expression. Wide, diffused daylight from the window on her left, very gentle shadows, a pale bounce of light on the shadow side. Simple off-white room, a hint of a wooden table and a ceramic cup out of focus. Oatmeal knit sweater. 85mm lens, aperture f/2, natural unretouched skin with fine texture, pastel neutral colour palette, soft contrast. Vertical 4:5 framing, chest-up, negative space on the right.
imageAlt: Woman in a knit sweater lit by a large window in a pale, quiet room
visualNotes: A large window on an overcast day behaves like a giant softbox. Because the light source is big relative to the subject, shadows fade gradually instead of ending in hard lines, which is what produces the quiet, painterly look described by the prompt.

customize.lighting: For a brighter, airy look add 'high-key' and 'sun-lit curtains'. For something more dramatic, specify 'late afternoon sun through blinds' and accept stripes of light on the wall.
customize.camera: A 50mm lens lets you include more of the room and window frame; 105mm gives a compressed, more intimate portrait.
customize.background: Replace the room with a greenhouse, a bookshop corner or a bare plaster wall. Keep the tones quiet so the face remains the focus.
customize.wardrobe: Plain cotton shirts, cardigans or a silk camisole all work. Avoid fine stripes, which can shimmer in generated images.
customize.mood: 'Relaxed, soft expression' can become 'mid-thought, looking down at a notebook' for a more narrative frame.
customize.composition: Leave the negative space if you plan to add text, such as a quote or a name for a social card. Otherwise centre the subject.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for feeds; request 3:2 landscape if you want more of the window and room in the frame.

title: Film-Inspired Portrait
description: A portrait with the colour and grain of a 35mm film photograph: slightly faded blacks, warm skin, green-leaning shadows and a candid, unposed feel. It is a good choice for nostalgic social posts and lifestyle feeds.
promptText: Candid 35mm film photograph of a woman in her mid-twenties sitting on the steps of a quiet street, laughing and looking away from the camera, a denim jacket over a white tee, hair loosely tied back. Overcast daylight with a hint of warm sun breaking through, slightly overexposed highlights. Visible film grain, soft halation around bright areas, faded blacks, warm skin tones with subtle green in the shadows. 35mm lens, aperture f/2.8, slight motion softness, natural unposed moment. Vertical 3:4 composition, three-quarter length, subject placed on the lower-left third.
imageAlt: Woman laughing on street steps in a warm, grainy 35mm film style
visualNotes: Film character comes from three things working together: lifted blacks, slight halation around highlights and a candid moment. The prompt asks for all three in plain language and avoids naming a specific film stock or brand, which keeps results more consistent across tools.

customize.lighting: Ask for 'direct flash on camera, slightly harsh' for a snapshot look, or 'soft shade under a tree' for a calmer image.
customize.camera: A 28mm lens gives a more documentary, close-to-the-action feel. Add 'slight tilt' for a casual, spontaneous angle.
customize.background: Swap the street for a beach boardwalk, a corner shop or a tram stop. Busy backgrounds suit the candid style if kept slightly out of focus.
customize.wardrobe: Printed summer dresses, a cardigan or a simple vest top all fit the era. Avoid logos and slogans.
customize.mood: Change 'laughing' to 'caught mid-blink' or 'staring at something off frame' for a more cinematic, uncertain feeling.
customize.composition: For a closer crop, ask for 'shoulders up' and reduce the street detail; for a scene shot, request 'full-length' and a wider frame.
customize.aspectRatio: 3:4 mimics classic film prints. For 4:5 feeds, state it explicitly so the image is not cropped awkwardly.

title: Natural Outdoor Portrait
description: A fresh daytime portrait of a woman in dappled park light, with greenery softly blurred behind and a genuine, unforced smile. It is designed for lifestyle bloggers, wellness brands and everyday profile images.
promptText: Natural outdoor portrait of a woman in her late twenties with dark curly hair, standing in a leafy park in late morning, genuine relaxed smile, gently looking toward the camera. Dappled sunlight filtering through tree leaves, soft open shade on her face, small highlights in her hair. Lush green foliage in the background melting into soft bokeh. Light yellow cotton shirt dress, a thin gold chain. 85mm lens, aperture f/2, fresh natural colours, true-to-life skin, clean and airy look. Vertical 4:5, waist-up, subject on the right third with space on the left.
imageAlt: Smiling woman in a yellow dress standing in a green park with dappled light
visualNotes: Open shade is the quiet hero of outdoor portraits: the subject stands where the sun does not hit directly, so the face is lit evenly by the sky. The dappled spots in the prompt are kept to the hair and background, not the face, where they would look messy.

customize.lighting: For a warmer tone ask for 'late afternoon, low sun from behind', and keep 'open shade on the face' so she does not turn into a silhouette.
customize.camera: A 35mm lens shows more of the park and path; a 135mm lens gives creamier bokeh and a more distant, flattering perspective.
customize.background: A flower market, an orchard or a lakeside path keep the same airy feel. Choose backgrounds with repeated, small shapes for pleasant bokeh.
customize.wardrobe: Linen trousers and a white blouse, or a light cardigan over a sundress, keep the look natural. Prefer solid, light colours.
customize.mood: Replace the smile with 'looking down at a flower in her hand' for a quieter, more editorial image.
customize.composition: The left-side space is useful for text overlays; remove the instruction if you want a tighter, centred portrait.
customize.aspectRatio: 4:5 for posts, 2:3 for pins and prints. State the ratio at the end of the prompt for best results.
